scripts.test:watch: concurrently "watchman-make -p 'firestore.template.rules' --run 'npm run generate:firestore:rules && npm run test'" "jest --watch"
scripts.test:emulator: npm run generate:firestore:rules && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore 'npm run test'
scripts.deploy:firestore:rules: npm run generate:firestore:rules && source ../scripts/load_env_vars.sh && firebase use $ENVIRONMENT --non-interactive --token $FIREBASE_TOKEN && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules --token $FIREBASE_TOKEN
